scope: Local macOS arm64 actual canonical SIP answer/resource preparation and abort with PCMU/PCMA, current independent route authority and retained native decoded audio. This is resource custody, not telephone duplex, endpoint confirmation or completed movement.
implemented: TelephoneReplacementMediaOrigin is minted only after the actual activation receipt is durable. Its immediate current read rechecks the frozen complete original/source/retained/operator and independent SIP account/Endpoint/logical membership scope, exact confirmed Call-ID and preparation expiry. It never constructs a native peer or NativeMediaOrigin for the SIP target.

Current Endpoint/Session acceptance constrains the actual negotiated SIP codec. The protected SIP context exposes bound codec metadata, including the actual payload type, without granting IO. The host prepares the Core-reserved guarded controller under an exact once-only resource attempt, configures one audio stream and mutes it. The sealed Core resource observation binds the pending replacement and original owner. Stream handles, generations, revision and actual codec shape are captured before metadata awaits and retained for retries.

Resource policy admits only exact initialization, first change and initial mute. Programme publication/receive, private prompt and signal/confirmation hooks remain default denied. No current Store interval is retained while idle. Actual network assertions require no RTP output while quarantined, current route revocation within two seconds, BYE and candidate physical removal, one call on replay, no public ready/result and unchanged original decoded native duplex.

Schema59 retains one telephone resource effect per reservation, immutable captures and snapshot digests. Tests reject duplicate attempts, wrong binding/Call-ID/generation/codec/readiness, revoked route/operator/Endpoint, and foreign captures. Record failure rolls back and retries only the original capture. Unknown plus late known facts cannot restore the root or authorize another controller. Abandoning a known submitted leg records uncertainty without asserting remote absence or erasing confirmed SIP/resource facts.
preliminary_findings: The initial metadata getter referenced an unavailable sink_ready method; the actual stream Bound source_ready fact is the correct negotiated lifecycle check. Corrected through a new prepared source directory and updated patch/source-lock digests, never by editing .deps.

The controlled Store fixture accepts Opus. Initial PCMU captures were correctly refused; controlled fixtures now use that accepted codec. Real production fixtures independently exercise negotiated PCMU and PCMA under their own logical Session acceptance.

Both initial real answers reached durable actual resources; their test assertions expected pcmu/pcma aliases while Core reports canonical g.711-mu/g.711-a. Corrected assertions preserve exact codec, shape and payload-type checks. Final tests verify remaining quarantine/cleanup assertions without panic shutdown noise.
ignored_scope: Standalone subprocess entrypoints are explicitly invoked by passing parent tests; they are not counted as additional passes.
unqualified: No telephone private decoded duplex, attributed answer/55# confirmation application, final scene movement/commit/adoption or independent established telephone owner. The retained signals and controller are preparation state only. No ready/completed movement is claimed.

Normal server profile construction/shutdown, the full voicemail/wrong-confirmation/late-old/unknown/restart matrix, telephone-to-other-device movement and selector/private-context churn remain required. Established signalling must transfer away from the preparation deadline and original source authorization, including session refresh/contact routing.

Unrelated wider native/Core/transport suites were not repeated here; prior reports remain historical. The changed public telephone paths and schema/current Store behavior are qualified by the listed tests. Non487 terminal-after-local-transport-failure, Linux/browser/remote/provider/PSTN/performance profiles and independent acceptance/publication remain unqualified.
